text:
Ellen M: flagging an oddity from our month-end deferral reconciliation. looks like some invoices have DEF-PROMO applied twice, resulting in duplicated deferred liability for the same underlying credit.
Ravi P: can you share invoice IDs / sample rows? this could inflate our deferred balance and make recognized revenue look lower.
Ellen M: pasted sample from deferral_extract.csv:
```
invoice_id,customer,invoice_date,deferral_code,deferral_amount
INV-2026-0601,omega-io,2026-04-05,DEF-PROMO,1200
INV-2026-0601,omega-io,2026-04-05,DEF-PROMO,1200
INV-2026-0610,zeta-sys,2026-04-18,DEF-PROMO,300
```
Ellen M: you can see INV-2026-0601 appears twice with same deferral line. total overstated $1,200 on deferred liability.
Jocelyn H: how did the duplicate happen? billing export or revenue scheduler?
Ellen M: root cause looks like a retry bug in the deferral-import lambda: if the job timed out after creating the deferral but before checkpointing, the fix re-ran and created a second deferral row. we've since patched the idempotency key.
Ravi P: materiality? total set of duplicates across dataset = $6,900.
Jocelyn H: okay > internal materiality threshold for month is $5k. we need a correcting JE and revenue schedule cleanup. prefer to reverse the duplicate deferrals rather than touch recognized revenue since recognition flow hasn't consumed the duplicated rows yet.
Ellen M: suggested JE: DR 2300-DEFERRED-PROMO $6,900 / CR 4000-REVENUE-DEFERAL-ERRATA $6,900 with memo "reverse duplicate deferral creation - ticket RR-2026-0599". then remove duplicate deferral rows from schedule.
Ravi P: agree. please attach list of affected invoices and the lambda log showing duplicate creation. also note control remediation in close memo.
revrec-bot: ticket RR-2026-0599 created and assigned to @Ellen M; due 2026-05-02; checklist: invoice list, lambda logs, patch PR link, JE template.
Ellen M: patch PR: https://git.internal/redwood/deferral-import/pull/99; will attach logs to ticket. posting JE during May close and recording schedule cleanup action.
Jocelyn H: i approve JE as accounting manager. Ravi?
Ravi P: approve. add footnote to May revenue schedule: "Correction of duplicate deferral lines created by retry behavior in deferral-import lambda (RR-2026-0599)."
Ellen M: noted. closing loop — thanks.
